edition: PMI PMP Exam Content Outline, July 2026

P1.title: Develop a common vision
enablers: Help ensure a shared vision with key stakeholders
Break down situations to identify root cause of vision misunderstanding

P2.title: Manage conflicts
enablers: Communicate conflict management principles with team and external stakeholders
Establish environment fostering adherence to common ground rules
Manage and rectify ground rule violations

P3.title: Lead the project team
enablers: Support team's varied experiences, skills, and perspectives
Establish clear roles and responsibilities within team

P4.title: Engage stakeholders
enablers: Analyze and tailor communication to stakeholder needs
Optimize alignment among stakeholder needs, expectations, and project objectives
Build trust and influence stakeholders to accomplish project objectives

P5.title: Align stakeholder expectations
enablers: Organize and act on mentoring opportunities

P6.title: Manage stakeholder expectations
enablers: Identify internal and external customer expectations
Align and maintain outcomes to internal and external customer expectations
Monitor internal and external customer satisfaction/expectations and respond as needed

P7.title: Help ensure knowledge transfer
enablers: Identify knowledge critical to the project

P8.title: Plan and manage communication
enablers: Create reports aligned with sponsor and stakeholder expectations

PR1.title: Develop an integrated project management plan and plan delivery
enablers: Assess project needs, complexity, and magnitude
Recommend project management development approach (predictive, adaptive/agile, or hybrid)
Estimate work effort and resource requirements
Assess consolidated project plans for dependencies, gaps, and continued business value
Collect and analyze data to make informed project decisions

PR2.title: Develop and manage project scope
enablers: Obtain stakeholder agreement on project scope

PR3.title: Help ensure value-based delivery
enablers: Identify value components with key stakeholders
Prioritize work based on value and stakeholder feedback
Assess opportunities to deliver value incrementally
Verify measurement system in place to track benefits
Evaluate delivery options to demonstrate value

PR4.title: Plan and manage resources
enablers: Define and plan resources based on requirements
Manage and optimize resource needs and availability

PR5.title: Plan and manage procurement
enablers: Verify objectives of procurement agreement are met

PR6.title: Plan and manage finance
enablers: Quantify risk and contingency financial allocations
Plan spend tracking throughout project life cycle
Monitor financial variations and work with governance process

PR7.title: Plan and optimize quality of products/deliverables
enablers: Gather quality requirements for project deliverables
Manage cost of quality (CoQ) and sustainability

PR8.title: Plan and manage schedule
enablers: Prepare schedule based on selected development approach
Coordinate with other projects and operations
Estimate project tasks (milestones, dependencies, story points)

PR9.title: Evaluate project status
enablers: Develop project metrics, analysis, and reconciliation
Help ensure artifacts are created, reviewed, updated, and documented
Measure, analyze, and update project metrics
Continually assess effectiveness of artifact management

PR10.title: Manage project closure
enablers: Obtain project stakeholder approval of project completion
Determine criteria to successfully close project or phase
Validate readiness for transition (e.g., to operations team or next phase)
Conclude activities to close project or phase (e.g., final lessons learned, retrospectives, procurement, financials, resources)

B1.title: Define and establish project governance
enablers: Describe and establish structure, rules, procedures, reporting, ethics, and policies through use of organizational process assets (OPAs)
Outline governance escalation paths and thresholds

B2.title: Plan and manage project compliance
enablers: Confirm project compliance requirements (e.g., security, health and safety, sustainability, regulatory compliance)
Determine necessary approach and action(s) to address compliance needs
Measure extent to which project is in compliance

B3.title: Manage and control changes
enablers: Update project documentation to reflect changes

B4.title: Remove impediments and manage issues
enablers: Determine and apply intervention strategy to remove/minimize impediments
Reassess continually to help ensure impediments, obstacles, and blockers for team are addressed
Collaborate with relevant stakeholders on approach to resolve issues

B5.title: Plan and manage risk
enablers: Maintain risk register (e.g., poor IT security)
Execute risk management plan (e.g., risk response for security and managing sustainability risks)
Communicate status of risk impact on project

B6.title: Continuous improvement
enablers: Help ensure continuous improvement processes are updated

B7.title: Support organizational change
enablers: Evaluate impact of organizational change on project and determine required actions

B8.title: Evaluate external business environment changes
enablers: Survey changes to external business environment (e.g., regulations, technology, geopolitical, market)
Assess and prioritize impact on project scope/backlog based on changes in external business environment
Continually review external business environment for impacts on project scope/backlog
